data.name: Empty_Assign
data.value: Assign data to {0} in a code cell and run it, then pick it from the {1} dropdown above.
data.comment: Text under Empty_Title. {0} is the variable name in code style, {1} is Toolbar_Data in bold.

data.name: Empty_Title
data.comment: Heading in the middle of the grid area when nothing is loaded.

data.name: Layout_Description
data.value: Isolated layout that presents a kernel DataBlock as an editable spreadsheet, or a DataTable read-only.
data.comment: Second line of the sample's entry in the Extensions panel. DataBlock and DataTable are type names and stay as written.

data.name: Layout_DisplayName
data.comment: Label in the layout picker. Stays as written.

data.name: Layout_Name
data.comment: Name of the sample extension as listed in the Extensions panel. 'Grid Studio' is the sample's name and stays as written; 'Layout' translates.

data.name: Select_NoData
data.comment: Only entry of the variable dropdown when the kernel holds no table.

data.name: Status_Bound
data.comment: Status bar text once a variable is loaded. {0} is the variable name.

data.name: Status_BoundReadOnly
data.comment: Status bar text once a read-only variable is loaded. {0} is the variable name.

data.name: Status_Committed
data.comment: Status bar text after a commit. {0} is the variable name.

data.name: Status_Dims
data.comment: Grid size at the right of the status bar. {0} is the row count, {1} the column count.

data.name: Status_Exported
data.comment: Status bar text after a download. {0} is the file name, such as sales.csv.

data.name: Status_Ready
data.comment: Status bar text before anything is loaded.

data.name: Status_Unsaved
data.comment: Status bar text while the grid has edits not yet committed.

data.name: Toolbar_Column
data.comment: Toolbar button that adds a column, drawn after a plus icon.

data.name: Toolbar_Commit
data.comment: Toolbar button that writes the edits back to the kernel variable.

data.name: Toolbar_Csv
data.comment: Toolbar button that downloads the grid as a CSV file. CSV is a format name and stays as written.

data.name: Toolbar_Data
data.comment: Label before the dropdown that picks the variable to show. Also quoted in Empty_Assign.

data.name: Toolbar_Delete
data.comment: Toolbar button that removes the selected rows.

data.name: Toolbar_Reload
data.comment: Toolbar button that re-reads the bound variable.

data.name: Toolbar_Row
data.comment: Toolbar button that adds a row, drawn after a plus icon.
